files.description: The sole EHI export documentation: a 10-page PDF describing the Praxis Data Export Utility. Contains step-by-step instructions with screenshots for performing EHI exports. Documents the export output structure (CDA XML summaries, .doc visit text files, attachments in original format, and an index.html demographic listing). No data dictionary or schema documentation included. Revision date November 14, 2023.

Screenshot of the Certification Disclosures and Costs page showing the 'Electronic Health Information Export' button that links to the DataExportDocumentation PDF, along with ONC certification details.
